title: C3 Skill Package Manifest
description: Structured manifest for a skill package built on the Agent Skills standard, with L0-L3 progressive loading and a declaration of which C2 events it subscribes to / may emit, and where it mounts in the bub turn pipeline. This schema covers the machine-readable manifest (e.g. skill frontmatter/metadata); free-form skill body content (SKILL.md prose) is out of scope.

layers.description: L0-L3 progressive disclosure. L0 (name+description) is always resident in context; L1 is loaded when the skill triggers; L2/L3 are loaded on demand, L3 being the heaviest (scripts, datasets, large references).

l1_body.description: Path to the skill's main body file (e.g. SKILL.md), loaded when the skill is triggered.

l2_references.description: Paths to reference files loaded on demand once the skill is active.

l3_resources.description: Paths to heavy resources (scripts, datasets, binaries) loaded only when explicitly invoked.

description.description: L0 summary, always resident in context; used to decide when to trigger the skill.

version.description: Semver of this skill package itself.

namespace.description: Which vertical this skill belongs to, or 'shared' for platform-level skills.

mount_points.description: bub turn-pipeline hook names this skill attaches to. Left as free-form strings pending bub's own hook-name reference; validated for non-emptiness of each entry, not against a fixed enum.

subscribes.description: C2 events this skill listens for.

emits.description: C2 events this skill may write to the tape.

allowed_tools.description: Optional allow-list of external tools this skill may invoke (mirrors Agent Skills allowed-tools).

requires_authorization.description: If true, this skill must not run unless a redteam.target.registered entry with a non-expired authorization is present on the tape (house rule 5).
